OtherNames: LNG del Plata FLNG; GNL del Plata
Location: Port of La Plata (Ensenada), Buenos Aires Province
ResearcherNotesProject: Export FLNG project unveiled Dec 2025 by Camuzzi Gas Inversora (controlled by Alejandro Macfarlane, Jorge Brito and an Italian group led by Fabrizio Garilli) at the Port of La Plata/Ensenada, Buenos Aires. Plans >2.4 mtpa via a floating liquefaction vessel; $3.9B over 20 yrs; construction targeted 2026, operations 2028. Apr 2026: Vitol signed MoU to offtake up to 100% of output and is evaluating an equity stake (Vitol not yet staged as Owner pending equity confirmation). Vessel not yet named -> FloatingVesselName blank; FSRU/FLNG sync check deferred until a vessel is identified. Distinct from existing GEM Argentina export records (Argentina LNG Terminal = Sierra Grande/Punta Colorada FLNG; TGS Puerto Galvan; Bahia Blanca FLNG). Confirm latest stage and FID timing in Update.

OtherNames: Tecpetrol modular LNG plant; Tecpetrol GNL Bahía Blanca
Location: Port of Bahía Blanca, Buenos Aires Province
ResearcherNotesProject: Standalone onshore modular liquefaction plant pursued by Tecpetrol (Techint Group's oil & gas arm), distinct from the YPF/Eni Argentina LNG and TGS Puerto Galvan projects. Initial 4 mtpa, scalable to 20 mtpa as a shared 'industrial park'; ONSHORE modules (not floating, unlike PAE/YPF). FEED stage; land reportedly already acquired in the Bahia Blanca port area; FID targeted H2 2025, first exports targeted H2 2027. Tecpetrol has separately been reported weighing joining the YPF consortium, but the Bahia Blanca modular plant is a distinct standalone proposal. Verify current stage/FID in Update; capacity and exact site to be confirmed.
